lines.english: "We bring you the news for February 14th, Valentine's Day."
"Let's start with a report from Miley Sports… 'Touma Kazusa's Additional Concert to be Canceled?'"
"Following the positive reception of her first concert in Japan held in January, pianist Touma Kazusa had made plans to hold an additional concert near the end of this month."
"However, recent statements made by related sources have cast doubt on any future performance being held, due to poor health."
"Neither Kazusa-san, nor her producer and mother, Touma Youko-san, have made any appearances before the press since the previous concert…"
"Thus, it is likely that her health has indeed deteriorated since the previous concert, and that she is currently recuperating in a hospital somewhere within the Metropolitan Area."
"In fact, just last week, an ambulance was dispatched late at night to the hotel where Kazusa-san was thought to have been staying."
"Eyewitness reports on the scene expressed the possibility that the woman carried out at the time was Kazusa-san herself, adding further concerns to whether the additional concert will be held."
"Furthermore, a statement made by Touma Youko Office last night had this to say regarding the issue: 'We have received no such report and are currently investigating the matter.'"
"Tickets for Touma Kazusa-san's first concert in Japan sold out within an hour, putting the demand for her performances at an unprecedented level for a classical musician…"
"Did you spread these rumors, Miyo-chan?"
"Whispers were spreading amongst the media that your health had been failing recently, so I thought that I'd mislead them with a false clue."
"…I see. Once it is made known Kazusa was fine all along, people will be more skeptical when my illness is reported on."
"It was you who taught me how to turn a crisis into an opportunity."
"I would expect no less of Touma Youko Office's best employee. Thanks!"
"I also happen to be the only employee in the Japanese branch."
"…So, how is she?"
"She's still not focusing on her piano practice. Sometimes I see her walking outside, but it never seems like she's doing anything more than just wandering aimlessly."
"You think she's in a bad mood?"
"I would think so… however, more than just being in a bad mood, she seems to be troubled by something."
"Troubled…?"
"Yes. Whenever I call out to her, she only gives me half-hearted replies, as if her heart's someplace else."
"President, do you really think she's okay? You don't think she's feeling a bit overwhelmed?"
"Ah, if that's all, then there should be no reason for you to worry, Miyo-chan."
"A-Are you sure? Being famous can come with a lot of hardships…"
"That girl is a lot more normal than people around her might think… I'd say she's a bit too innocent for her own good."
"I-Innocent…?"
"So you shouldn't worry about her giving up on life. I can't say the same about her giving up on being famous, however."
"I'm sorry, Miyo-chan. My daughter is causing you a lot of trouble."
"It's okay. I understand her feelings almost too well."
"…I highly doubt that."
"I'm so shocked I want to cry too. What would happen to Touma Youko Office if you retired…?"
"Well, let's worry about that when I leave the hospital. More importantly, how's preparation for the next concert going?"
"All preparations are already in order on that end, be it to commence it… or to revoke it. Part of the reason I spread that report was in order to do this."
"…You truly are Touma Youko Office's best employee!"
"The moment you made your decision, I started working on everything on all sides, minimizing the possible damage."
"Thank you, Miyo-chan."
"But what are we going to do about Kazusa-san? I'm not just talking about the concert, but after the concert too…"
"For now, we can only watch over her."
"President…"
"Will she be able to return to her old self? Will she end up losing everything? Or perhaps…"
"Will she throw something away to gain something else?"
"Ah, um… excuse me."
"Aren't you the pianist Touma Kazusa-san?"
"I knew it! I thought that you looked familiar! Ah, I went to your last concert!"
"N-No, I…"
"I was so touched by it! I usually don't listen to classical music, but I'm a big fan of your performances!"
"Huh, I see…?"
"I mean, the way you play is so beautiful and so incredibly picturesque～ Just looking at you is satisfying enough."
"Please shake my hand, please! Ah, and also if it's okay, a signature too…"
"…By the way, where are you going? You're going to stay in Japan a while longer, right? You still have your additional concert to play, after all."
"…You're wrong."
"I'm… not that famous."
"B-But… you are Touma-san, right?"
"So what if I am?"
"Eh, eh?"
"Touma Kazusa… is just an ordinary Japanese person you can find anywhere."
"We're nearing our last stop, Narita Airport. Please make sure you have all your baggage with you when you step off. We would like to thank you for traveling with…"
"Hey, Kitahara! What's the matter with you recently?"
"Sorry. I've been really busy with the special issue."
"That's fine! But you haven't shown your face around at all, and you haven't reported your progress either. And how come you never even greet me when you pass by?"
"I'm really sorry. This week I have been busy frequenting Ensemble's editing department."
…I continue writing, and answer without even turning my head, which only serves to anger Hamada-san further.
I know I shouldn't say it, but I don't have any time to lose talking.
"So, how is the special issue going? You better not come crying to me that you won't be able to make it in time!"
"I'll get the first draft finished today. As things stand right now, everything should be done by the weekend."
"…W-What?"
"Isn't that a bit too fast? The deadline is in half a month."
"All that's left now is to wait for the revision and compilation work to finish… as well as the supervisors' and editors' post-scripts."
"I felt some ill-will toward me in that last part…"
"You're overthinking it, Macchan."
"I-If you're making that much progress, then report it! Don't keep everything to yourself!"
"I apologize. I'll be more careful from now on… If you'll excuse me, may I continue writing?"
"…Make a detailed report later. An email is fine."
"Understood."
I'd rather not waste time writing an email, but I'll have to do it, perhaps on the train home.
Let alone reporting my progress, I've been so strapped for time I didn't even waste time entertaining the thought of writing one since the beginning of the week.
That kind of workflow is simply unfit for a respectable employee, as Hamada-san suggested. But I don't want to waste time even thinking about that.
After all…
No, let's not even think of that possibility. Nothing is decided yet.
"Hey, Suzuki-san… Don't you think Kitahara is acting a bit strange?"
"Well, I wouldn't expect you to understand what kind of person he is, Macchan. He was Mari-san's favorite pupil, after all."
"No… I remember Mari-san saying something about 'dangerous Kitahara.' I feel like he's becoming similar to that."
Perhaps it's because I've been overworking since the beginning of the week, or perhaps it's because I've been so utterly focused.
My senses feel so sensitive right now; I feel like I can hear every single word being spoken around me.
However, I still had no time to butt in, nor did I want to.
I simply have to finish my work for the day as soon as possible.
And besides, I can't say Matsuoka-san is wrong. The situation I find myself in is entirely of my own doing.
"…What kind of joke is this?"
"Stop trying to mess with me with an awful joke like that…"
"Then I'll be there for you."
"…Even if it means I have to throw everything else away."
The words that had left my mouth just a few seconds earlier, like Kazusa said, truly did come off as an awful joke.
"I know that you don't mean it. But my hopes will still go up… and it'll only bring me more sadness."
"Is… having me around something sad for you? Is the idea of always being with me that bad?"
"You moron! Stop misinterpreting my words on purpose! I hate that part about you!"
"…I'm sorry."
Hiding my embarrassment has no purpose when talking to Kazusa as she is now.
"It's because I feel like I might wake up from this dream… I'll wake up and be reminded that this could never happen."
"Kazusa…"
Because Kazusa herself has stopped hiding her feelings, and has stopped pretending to be strong.
"Don't promise me things that can't happen. There is a limit to how cruel someone can be, you know?"
Instead, she put all her energy into looking at nothing but me.
…Removing anything from her vision that wasn't me.
"Even so… I'm sorry to say that you're completely mistaken."
"Huh…?"
"I'm not lying at all. I'm not messing with you either."
So I too will answer Kazusa truthfully. I'll remove everything from my vision but her.
"From now on, I'll always be with you. I'll follow you wherever you go… Even to Vienna if I have to."
"Whether it's the famous pianist Touma Kazusa, or the ordinary Japanese girl Touma Kazusa. It makes no difference to me."
"Haruki…?"
"All that matters is that I'll support that one person. From now on, I will live solely for her."
"You, you…!"
Yet, the more I answer her feelings…
The more I promise to fulfill her wishes…
"Have you lost your mind?"
The air around us grows colder, but for a different reason than the weather.
We're walking down a road that leads to no happiness…
Only despair, enveloping dark clouds, and unimaginable pressure await us on this path.
"But that's only the dream I desperately wished for, it wouldn't actually happen, would it…?"
"Even abroad I'll be fine… I'll probably have a lot of difficulties at first, but I'm sure I can get proper employment there eventually."
"That's not what I'm talking about…!"
"You don't have to worry about my family. I've been away from them for the most part anyway…"
"…! That's not what I'm talking about at all! You're misinterpreting me on purpose again, aren't you?"
"I guess so…"
"What about Setsuna…?"
"…!? Don't tell me… you can't have…!?"
Kazusa got the wrong idea for a short while, but then immediately understands.
That true cruelty isn't in promising to fulfill a dream that can't come true.
"…You don't have to worry about that. I'll… manage that by myself, somehow."
"Ah, ah… Aaaaah!?"
Because the very moment that dream does come true, it'll also mark the beginning of a time of true despair.
"Boarding for East Japan Airlines Flight 248 to Vienna is now open. Passengers of this flight, please head to Gate 82."
"Aah…"
"That's impossible… Haruki…"
"…Of course that's impossible!"
"Then what are you going to do from now on? Are you going to live on by yourself? Can you… give me peace of mind knowing you will manage?"
"I'm not talking about myself… I'm talking about you! It's too much for you!"
"If you did that… You'd make everyone miserable for my sake. Setsuna… yourself… everyone!"
"I'll… be fine."
"Of course you won't be fine! You'll be the worst off in all of this!"
"I told you, I'll be fine…"
"But you love Setsuna; you both wanted to be with each other for the rest of your lives!"
"Kazusa…"
"If you do this… If you abandon the person who has loved you so earnestly for five years, you'll regret it for the rest of your life."
"Kazusa."
"How can you…!?"
"Kazusa!"
"It's too late."
"It's not too late at all… You haven't decided anything yet! You don't have to…"
"There is no choice I can make anymore that I won't come to regret."
"Eh?"
"If I abandon you now when you need me so much, I'll never be able to forgive myself."
"But that's…"
"No matter what I do, it's hopeless. It's far too late to make things right. That's why I…"
"W-Wait… wait a minute!"
"I've decided that, if nothing else… I'll save the person who's most important to me."
"Y-You… You idiot!"
"For once… you're probably right."
"～～～!? Uah, aah, aaaah…!"
"You… You can't do that… You can't… Haruki…!"
"Kazusa…"
"Don't… Don't make me… even more dependent on you…!"
"…! It's because you always put things that way, that I can't bring myself to leave you."
"…! I'm s…sorry… Aah… Aaaah!"
"Hey, Kazusa…"
"Ngh… uug… What… is it?"
"Of course, even if that's my choice, it's pointless if it brings you no happiness."
"Haruki…?"
"If you feel like you'll be happier without me…"
"If you feel like you can manage on your own, then push me away."
"Eh?"
"All I care about anymore is your happiness. That's all I need to make my resolve."
"But that's, that's, that's… How could… I, how…"
"…In the end, I'm only causing you more pain. I'm sorry."
"But I still want the final choice to be yours."
"Mine…?"
"I think that like me, you'll regret your choice no matter what it is."
"That's why at least… Your regret should be of your own choice. That when you betray those you love, you'll remember that."
"Betray…?"
"I've already betrayed them. The rest is up to you."
"Will you decide to continue living in despair as you are now? Or will you choose to live a life filled with greater pain, but also one filled with greater happiness?"
"Please think about it."
"Haruki…"
"No matter what you choose, I'll do everything to see it through."
"Even if that means I have to make a deal with the devil."
"Haruki…"
"This is the final boarding call for East Japan Airlines Flight 248 bound for Vienna. All passengers, please proceed immediately to Gate 82 to board. Thank you."
"I'm… I'm…"
"Touma!"
"Hey, Oda! The gate is not that way!"
"Huh…?"
"Huh? But it says the flight to Frankfurt is at Gate 70."
"Yes, but it's the wrong airline! Check your ticket, would you?"
"Oh, you're right. Why do they have to make things so complicated…?"
"They leave at about the same time, is all. Come on, let's get to Gate 54."
"My bad, let's go."
"Be more careful… Are you sure you won't get lost on the way back?"
"Ha, haha…"
"What's that supposed to mean? Aren't you done with work for today? You have no meetings or interviews either, right?"
"Right…"
"So why do you keep saying that you can't make it? At least say that you might be late…"
"I've told you already. We're nearing the deadline, so I don't know when they might need me. I need to be available within 30 minutes of being called."
"Then just shut off your phone or something. You're efficient enough to make up for a day's work."
"I can't do that either… This is the first time they've entrusted me with the front page."
"Is your job more important than your girlfriend? Have you forgotten what day it is?"
"Of course I remember… what kind of day today is."
"…Haruki."
"Hm?"
"Your voice has been sounding faint since we started talking, you know."
"Eh?"
"Or perhaps it's just that your voice is getting drowned out. I can hear your surroundings."
"…You're just imagining it."
"You're feeling down about something… Do you really…"
"The train is leaving on Line 2. Please mind the closing doors."
"Ah, sorry… I have to get off the train. I'm hanging up."
"In any case, come! Io and I will go ahead…"
I end the call and rush toward the door before it closes, as if to attempt to avoid hearing the rest of what Takeya had to say.
This week is the first time I'm able to go home before midnight… No, normally I wouldn't even go home today.
It would usually take me a station's travel from Minami-Suetsugu to Suetsugu-chou, after which I'd need to take a fifteen-minute walk.
It's February 14th… Setsuna's birthday, and there's a party for her every year.
The idea of holding a big home party on your birthday past the age of twenty might be laughable for those uninvolved…
Even so, to the participants of this party in particular, it's an expected, sacred and sublime event that they look forward to every year.
Both family and friends gather in large numbers, casually chatting and eating from the grand buffet that the birthday girl made.
The party itself feels very western, yet contains something very uniquely Japanese, like a perfect blend of traditional Japanese and western styles.
I was at the center of the celebration last year and the year before that as the number one target for the other guests who had attended those parties.
…All because I dared to make the birthday girl mine.
That's why, this year…
"Your voice has been sounding faint since we started talking, you know."
"Or perhaps it's just that your voice is getting drowned out?"
How could my voice not grow weaker…?
After all, I… as things are now…
A few days have passed since then… I haven't heard anything from Kazusa, and I haven't contacted her either.
Back then, Kazusa merely glared at me with tears in her eyes, neither throwing herself into my arms nor rejecting me. Instead, she merely turned her back toward me and walked away in silence.
It was so the both of us could have time to think about things. So we could dedicate everything to ensure that we both know where we stand.
We never set a deadline for such a conclusion.
My hopes and anxieties for this situation to resolve within a day or two were for naught, making me realize that I'd need to steel my resolve for much longer on the fifth day.
Her next concert is in two weeks. And today, having still not heard any decision from Kazusa, I head toward Setsuna's house.
Perhaps I can find solace in knowing that we're surrounded by friends and family, or…
"…Hey."
Really, this girl…
I can't see a trace of her anywhere when I'm dying to meet her, but she always happens to show up when I least expect it.
"It's been five days. Have you been doing well?"
"I should be asking you the same thing…"
"Of course I haven't been well. Not when you pushed that awful choice onto me. I thought that I too was going to get sick and collapse."
"Well…"
Almost as if she had forgotten how cruel a choice I had made…
As if not even aware of how I have felt these past days waiting for her, Kazusa merely looks at me teasingly.
"Why are you looking at me like that? It's almost like you're regretting your choice, like I said you would."
"Of course not…"
"Well, I suppose it's only natural."
If you know already, then don't bring it up…
How could I not be regretting this? I said from the very beginning I would.
After all, after all…
"When thinking about the weight of what you said, it'd be weirder not to regret it."
Why do I… have to separate from Setsuna?
I love her… I could never come to hate her.
I swore to her that my feelings would never change again. …And I believed in what I promised her.
And yet… yet…
Why am I forced to make this decision… for the sole reason that I love Kazusa too…?
"What's your answer?"
But I understand now. Kazusa has made her resolve.
"You're going to give an answer soon, right? About whether you'll choose me or if you'll abandon me…?"
She's aware that my feelings would waver over the few days that she was given to come to a conclusion.

She's aware that after the day I'd said what I'd said to her in the heat of the moment, I might have spent the painstaking days that followed trying to put my feelings in order and come back to reality.
"I went to the airport…"
"I didn't plan to return to Vienna or anything. I didn't even have a ticket."
"Then, why?"
"I just wanted to remember…"
"Remember… what?"
"The sadness I felt when we parted five years ago… That painful feeling that could tear my body apart."
"And I tried to compare it to the pain everyone else would feel from my foolish choice."
"And…?"
Kazusa was trying to respect my resolve more than her own feelings.
And if I were to suddenly change my mind, she would have accepted it.
"You never asked, did you? Why I was waiting here for you…"
"Right…"
"You knew I'd figure it out, didn't you? About the place you are most certain to go to today."
"Haruki… You were planning on going to Setsuna's birthday party, weren't you? That's why you got off at this station."
"I did…"
"You were going to see her, but you wouldn't be able to say anything about me. You'd just hand her a present, eat together, and then finally, give her a kiss goodbye, right?"
"Kazusa…"
"And then you would regret everything. You'd tell yourself to give up on me, and reaffirm that you love Setsuna more than anything after all."
"I wouldn't…"
"I knew. I knew that your feelings were still conflicted. I knew how much you would regret your choice."
"Kazusa, I…"
"…But even then, it's all over."
"Eh?"
"I came here as fast as I could from the airport. I came here by train, taxi and on my own two legs, and just barely made it in time."
"I came here to stop you… I came here to take you away."
"Kazusa…?"
"Please… don't see Setsuna from now on."
Kazusa tried to respect my decision more than her own feelings.
And if I were to suddenly change my mind, she would have accepted it.
"Haruki… I want you to betray Setsuna. And I want you to choose me."
"Aah, ah…"
But it seems I've managed to overcome Kazusa's trap.
I've won this game of deception with the devil, and signed a contract in the depths of hell.
"Please… Always, always be by my side…!"
"You're sure, right?"
"I love you!"
"You'll be left with nothing but me and your piano. You're okay with that?"
"I'd be fine with just you."
And in that moment of victory, Kazusa looked very pained and sorrowful…
But also unbelievably happy.
"Kazusa!"
"Ah, mh!"
At that moment… we exchanged our vows in each other's embrace, and the natural next step would have been to share a passionate kiss…
But instead of moving any further at this stage, she merely puts her lips against my finger.
Nothing is over yet… And I know how horrible it will be to end it.
"Nm, nmh, nmu."
Even though I can sense hesitation in her lips, I can also sense she desires more.
The finger touching her lips soon becomes enveloped by her mouth, and I feel the force of her teeth.
"Mh, mhah…"
"Ah…"
I can feel the tip of my finger getting licked, and then suddenly, a sharp pain.
"Nhm… mh, ah… Haruki…"
The strength of her teeth grows gradually stronger. And once blood starts flowing from my finger, Kazusa swallows.
"From now on… you belong to me."
And with this, we establish an oath signed in blood.
